About Powernation Technologies

Powernation Technologies is a technology and digital solutions company based in Borrowdale, Harare, Zimbabwe.

We combine professional printing with software development so that clients can get their materials, their website and their business systems from one team. We work with individuals, startups and established businesses.

Our approach is practical. We listen to the problem, recommend the simplest solution that works, and explain it in plain language, whether that is a print job or a custom system.

    Software development in Zimbabwe

    Websites, web applications, mobile apps and business systems that reduce manual work, keep your information organised and help you make better decisions.

    Reduce manual work

    Replace repeated typing, copying and calculating with software that does it for you.

    Manage information

    Keep customers, sales, stock and records in one organised, searchable place.

    Improve productivity

    Give your team clear tools and automatic updates so they spend time on real work.

    Make better decisions

    See accurate, current figures instead of waiting for month-end summaries.

    Business website development

    Professional, mobile-friendly websites that present your business, services and contact details, with enquiry forms and clear calls to action.

    Problem it addresses
    Customers cannot find you online, or a poor website makes your business look less credible than it is.
    Benefits
    • Look credible to new customers
    • Receive enquiries around the clock
    • Easy to read and use on phones

    Custom web application development

    Browser-based tools built around the way your business works, such as booking systems, order tracking, client portals and internal tools.

    Problem it addresses
    Spreadsheets, paper and chat threads cannot handle shared work between several people.
    Benefits
    • One shared place for your data
    • Use it from any device with a browser
    • Grows as your business grows

    Mobile application development

    Android and iOS apps for customers or staff, built to be simple, fast and useful in everyday conditions.

    Problem it addresses
    Customers and field staff need access to your service or data from their phones.
    Benefits
    • Reach customers on the device they use most
    • Capture data on site, not later at a desk
    • One app design for Android and iOS

    Business management systems

    Systems that bring sales, customers, staff, suppliers and finances together in one place, with the roles and permissions you need.

    Problem it addresses
    Business information is scattered across notebooks, spreadsheets and chat messages.
    Benefits
    • See the whole business in one place
    • Fewer mistakes and duplicated entries
    • Control who can see and change what

    Inventory and stock management systems

    Track stock in and out, set reorder levels and follow items across shops, stores or farms.

    Problem it addresses
    Stock runs out unexpectedly, is over-ordered, or goes missing without anyone noticing.
    Benefits
    • Know what you have at any time
    • Reorder before you run out
    • Spot losses and slow-moving items

    Point of Sale (POS) systems

    Fast checkout with product lists, receipts, cashier accounts and daily sales summaries.

    Problem it addresses
    Handwritten sales records are slow, and cash totals are hard to reconcile at the end of the day.
    Benefits
    • Quicker, more accurate checkout
    • Daily sales reports without manual adding
    • Clear records for each cashier

    Business dashboards and reporting systems

    Live dashboards and reports that turn your records into charts and figures you can act on.

    Problem it addresses
    Decisions are made on guesswork because reports take days to compile.
    Benefits
    • See sales, stock and costs at a glance
    • Compare periods and spot trends
    • Share clear reports with partners and staff

    Database design and management

    Well-structured, secure databases for your business data, including moving information out of spreadsheets, with backups.

    Problem it addresses
    Data is duplicated, inconsistent or at risk of being lost.
    Benefits
    • One reliable source of truth
    • Faster searching and reporting
    • Safer data with backups

    Workflow automation

    Automate repeated tasks such as notifications, approvals, report sending and data capture.

    Problem it addresses
    Staff spend hours on repetitive manual tasks that cause delays and errors.
    Benefits
    • Save staff time on routine work
    • Fewer human errors
    • Consistent follow-up with customers

    Custom software solutions

    Software designed for the specific needs of your business when ready-made tools do not fit.

    Problem it addresses
    Off-the-shelf software forces you to change how you work, or cannot do what you need.
    Benefits
    • Built around your process
    • Only the features you need
    • Room to change as you grow

    How we work

    A clear process for software projects and larger print jobs, so you always know what happens next.

    1. Consultation

      We listen and learn about your business, your challenges and what you want to achieve.

    2. Planning

      We identify the right solution, agree the scope and explain what it involves.

    3. Development

      We design and build the solution, and keep you informed along the way.

    4. Testing

      We check that everything works properly and meets the quality we agreed.

    5. Delivery

      We launch or hand over the finished solution and show you how to use it.

    6. Support

      We provide assistance and improvements where agreed.

    Frequently asked questions

    What does Powernation Technologies do?

    We are a technology and digital solutions company in Borrowdale, Harare. We offer professional printing services and software development, including websites, web and mobile apps and business systems.

    How do I place a print order?

    Use the order form on this page to add one or more items, enter your details and send the order to us on WhatsApp or by email. We reply with a quote before any printing starts.

    Will I know the price before you print?

    Yes. We confirm your quote before printing starts, and no payment is taken on this website.

    Do you deliver, or do I collect?

    You can collect in store in Borrowdale, or choose delivery when you place your order.

    Can you build software for my kind of business?

    We build custom software around how your business works. Tell us about the problem you want to solve, and we will recommend a suitable solution and give you a quote.

    How much does a software project cost and how long does it take?

    It depends on what you need. After a consultation we agree the scope, the timeline and the price with you. You can also give us an optional budget range in the enquiry form.

    Do you offer support after delivery?

    Yes, where agreed. Support and improvements are discussed and agreed with you before the project is delivered.

    When will 3D printing be available?

    It is coming soon. Use the Notify Me form on this page and we will contact you when it launches.

    What are your opening hours?

    We are open every day from 7am to 8pm, and on Sundays from 11am to 7pm.

    How can I contact you?

    Message us on WhatsApp on 0714 523 203, email powernationtechnologies@gmail.com, send us an enquiry using the form below, or follow @powernationtech on Instagram.
